data.name: AlHanifa
data.gender_notes: AlHanifa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Al-Hanif', which means 'The Straightforward One' or 'The Monotheist'. This name is used to describe individuals who follow the true path of Allah. The name AlHanifa carries the meaning “The Straightforward One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlHanifa usually hope their child will grow to embody the straightforward one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes staying true to one's faith and following the righteous path.
data.etymology: AlHanifa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Straightforward One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlHanifa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: الحنيفة
in_arabic.meaning: الحنيفة تعني الشخص الذي يلتزم بالحق والصدق
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحنيفة هو اسم مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ح-ن-ف، والذي يعني الميل إلى شيء والانحراف عنه. الحنيفة في الإسلام تعني الشخص الذي يلتزم بالحق والصدق، وينحرف عن الباطل والكذب. هذا الاسم يدل على صفة من صفات الله تعالى، وهي الحنيفية، التي تعني التوحيد والانفراد بالعبادة لله وحده.

in_english.name: AlHanifa
in_english.meaning: AlHanifa means one who adheres to truth and honesty
in_english.long_meaning: The name AlHanifa is derived from the Arabic root ح-ن-ف (ḥ-n-f), which signifies inclining towards something or deviating from it. In Islamic tradition, AlHanifa refers to a person who commits to truth and righteousness, shunning falsehood. This name is associated with one of God's attributes, Al-Ḥanīfah, emphasizing monotheism and the exclusive worship of God. It symbolizes purity of intention, devotion to the truth, and spiritual integrity.
